gist.headline: The map got redrawn
gist.blurb: The API field guide has been regenerated from the production OpenAPI spec. Fewer mystery endpoints, more reliable breadcrumbs.
gist.summary: Regenerated APIDOCS.md from the current production OpenAPI specification, bringing the published API reference in line with deployed endpoints and schemas.
gist.impact: Developers can use the refreshed API reference to find the current request formats, parameters, and responses without guessing what production accepts.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a tiny cartographer in a cozy garden workshop, updating a large API map from a glowing retro terminal while code-vines and labeled endpoint flowers grow around it. The map represents the regenerated reference matching production.
